scenario: 建客户 + 拒绝营销订阅 — happy path
input: 新建一个客户：Jane Doe，邮箱 jane.doe@example.com，不要给她订阅营销邮件

semantic_rubric: 不要订阅营销 → --no-marketing (the default is subscribe, so the flag MUST be set)
--email XOR --phone respected: email given, phone not set

scenario: 建客户但邮箱/手机都缺 — must ask, never fabricate contact info
input: 帮我建一个新的客户档案

semantic_rubric: does not fabricate an email or phone (one of the two is required, no default)
does not ask about name / tags / marketing (all optional or defaulted)
explains email XOR phone if it asks for both — only one is needed

input: 查一下手机号 13800138000 的客户信息

semantic_rubric: phone filter used, no time bounds invented
any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r

scenario: 客户总数 — customers 没有 +count shortcut, 正确用 count leaf
input: 我们店一共有多少注册客户？

semantic_rubric: there is NO customers +count shortcut — the count LEAF is the correct tier; does not invent customers +count
does not list all customers and count them manually

notes: Tier trap: products/orders have +count, customers does not (shortcuts are only +create and +search).
